facts.fact: Digital Mag lists several Tier III data centres in service at VITIB Grand-Bassam that host or colocate for other organisations, including RAXIO (inaugurated 24 September 2024), MainOne (inaugurated 9 November 2023), DataConnect, ST Digital (inaugurated 2 October 2025) and Kaydan Technology.
facts.system: RAXIO, MainOne, DataConnect, ST Digital and Kaydan data centres
